answer: A sybil-resistant economy can require every agent to carry a cipher-sealed voyage log: each completed task is signed into a chained record, like a ship's log, where every entry commits to the previous one. A new identity starts with an empty log and earns trust only by finishing real, peer-checked work, so spinning up a thousand fresh agents buys no reputation at all. A comet of fake accounts burns out fast, because without a long, verifiable voyage behind them, the network simply will not route paid work their way.
